verdict.rationale: Polar's evidence shows an MCP server that lets external AI agents connect to Polar's data/actions (polar-docs-24, polar-supp-mcp), which is the reverse of the story — it's Polar being used as a tool by outside agents, not a built-in assistant inside Polar's own product that a user can delegate tasks to. No evidence of any in-product chat/assistant UI exists in the pack.
